newsitem.title: USA: Program trading 14.2 pct NYSE volume Feb 18-21.
newsitem.headline: Program trading 14.2 pct NYSE volume Feb 18-21.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Thursday that program trading accounted for 14.2 percent of its average daily volume for the week of February 18 through February 21.
That amounted to 70.4 million shares per day out of an average volume of 494.1 million shares.

For all markets, program trading averaged 109.4 million shares per day during that week, the New York exchange said. About 64.3 percent of all program trading took place on the NYSE, 30 percent on non-U.S. markets and 5.7 percent on other United States markets, including Nasdaq.
